about.title: Brazilian Portuguese Linguist with 5+ years of experience
about.description:
I spent two years on-site in Dublin, Ireland, working as an in-house translator and editor for two leaders in the gaming industry: Bungie (Destiny 2) and Supercell (live-service mobile games).

During my time in these multicultural environments, I worked directly with LQA testers and international teams to deliver high-quality localizations, maintaining strict glossary consistency for titles that reach millions of active players.

Now back in Brazil, I work as a freelance linguist. Check out my projects in the section below!

project.desc.skygard: Skygard Arena é um jogo de confronto tático e estratégico em turnos. Escolha 3 campeões e personalize-os para criar equipes com sinergia. Faça movimentos inteligentes e combine seus feitiços sabiamente a cada turno. Conclua missões na campanha ou enfrente outros jogadores no JxJ!

project.description.p4_0339: An impossible locked-room murder: Captain Mortuga lies dead beside an ancient cauldron aboard the world’s strangest submarine, crewed by sketchy suspects. A handcrafted point-and-click with sharp humour and tricky puzzles. Dive into the next mystery from the creators of Tangle Tower & Crow Country.
project.description.p5_5094: Um simulador de física de mundo aberto. Construa rovers mecanizados e transporte cargas desajeitadas por toda a superfície de Marte. Receba fundos, desbloqueie novas partes e use sua criatividade para estabelecer uma nova colônia no espaço! Jogue solo ou no multijogador online!
project.description.p6_1777: Unwind a 10 billion yen conspiracy in Tokyo's red-light district, fueled by your fists and unyielding resolve that will make you a legend.
project.description.p7_8555: Face off against the most powerful yakuza in the Kansai region of Japan in an explosive conflict between rival clans, loaded with brutal brawling action, immersive exploration, and unforgettable experiences.
project.description.p8_7551: Enter Evil Nun's nightmare. Trapped in a cursed school, escape from Sister Madeline. She's cunning, searching every corner, luring and talking to you depending on your actions. Solve puzzles, craft items, and uncover the mystery in this horror game with different escape routes.
project.description.p9_4124: Face the challenges of The Tower as you enroll into the Alchemy Academy in this action-packed, third-person, roguelite. Brew potions to boost yourself in the heat of battle and use multiple weapons to defeat dangerous foes and pass your exams!
